title: 第1章 会说话的狐狸开局发老婆第2章 妾身有礼
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
“这给我干哪来了，不会嘎我腰子吧……”
沈无名失魂落魄地打量着周围，嘴唇干裂，脸上汗水夹杂着风沙。
一下午了，他还是没法接受这个现实。
高考结束后，他第一次离开西红柿孤儿院，去泰山旅游。
结果一觉醒来，就在风沙漫天的荒野上了。
叫天天不应，叫地地不灵。
走了好久，才发现远处山麓下有一座沧桑斑驳的城镇。
可望山跑死马，从正午走到傍晚，都没有缩短多少距离。
“咕咕咕！”
肚子在叫，沈无名掏了掏荷包，什么都没有。
醒来之后，除了衣服还在，他的烟、打火机和手机全都不见了。
只是脑子里面多了一个面板，不过面板没有任何信息。
只有简单一行字。
【检测到你成功穿越异世界，受到原世界馈赠，你获得了逆天悟性】
有啥卵用？能吃不？
沈无名咽了咽口水，以滋润干得冒烟的喉咙。
自嘲一笑，继续朝着城镇而去，旁边忽然传来声音。
“嘤嘤嘤！”
他连忙扭头望去。
“有人？”

“嘤嘤嘤！”
这声音似乎不像人类，有点像小奶狗，不过更加的尖细。
环顾四周，他才找到声音的来源，就在土丘后边。
沈无名走过去拨开草丛，这才发现一团白色的毛茸茸。
“是只小狐狸啊。”
沈无名眼睛一亮，如今环境不明，他最担心的就是食物。
看到这只小狐狸，他顿时心头就有了着落，“可惜没有打火机。”
这只小狐狸没多少凶性，浑身皮毛都绒绒的，也没有什么腥骚味。
“不用加香料。”沈无名心头暗道。
小狐狸瞪大眼睛望着他，满是恐惧和惊慌，似乎想要挣扎。
可随即又扑通倒下，发出那“嘤嘤嘤”的惨叫声，后腿也渗出鲜血。
沈无名走过去，一只手拎住狐狸的后颈皮，防止它逃脱。
然后踩住捕兽夹的边缘，另一只手用力把捕兽夹掰开。
将小狐狸提溜起来。
“晚饭有着落了……”
沈无名心头暗松一口气，不过就在此时，耳边突然传来一道清脆的声音。
content_en:
"Where did this come from? It won't hurt my waist..."
Shen Wuming looked around in despair, his lips were chapped, and his face was covered with sweat mixed with wind and sand.
It's been an afternoon and he still can't accept this reality.
After the college entrance examination, he left the Tomato Orphanage for the first time and traveled to Mount Tai.
As a result, when I woke up, I was in the windy and sandy wilderness.
The sky is not responding to the call, and the earth and the earth are not working.
After walking for a long time, I discovered a town with vicissitudes of life at the foot of the mountain in the distance.
Kewangshan was a dead horse. From noon to evening, the distance did not shorten much.
"Cuckoo!"
His stomach was growling, and Shen Wuming took out his wallet, but found nothing.
After waking up, except for his clothes, his cigarette, lighter and mobile phone were all gone.
There is just an extra panel in my mind, but there is no information on the panel.
Just one simple line of text.
[It has been detected that you have successfully traveled through a different world and received a gift from the original world, and you have gained heaven-defying enlightenment]
What's the use of eggs? Can you eat it?
Shen Wuming swallowed to moisten his dry and smoking throat.
Smiling to himself, he continued towards the town when a voice suddenly came from beside him.
"嘤嘤嘤!"
He quickly turned around and looked.
"Is there anyone?"
"嘤嘤嘤!"
The voice didn't seem to be human, it was a bit like a puppy, but it was shriller.
Looking around, he found the source of the sound, which was behind the mound.
Shen Wuming walked over and pushed aside the grass, only to find a ball of white fur.
"It's a little fox."
Shen Wuming's eyes lit up. Now that the environment was unclear, what he was most worried about was food.
Seeing this little fox, he immediately had an idea in his mind, "It's a pity that there is no lighter."
This little fox doesn't have much ferocity, its fur is fluffy, and it doesn't have any fishy smell.
"No need to add spices." Shen Wuming thought to himself.
The little fox stared at him with wide eyes, full of fear and panic, and seemed to want to struggle.
But then he fell down again, letting out a scream of "嘤嘤嘤嘤", and blood oozed from his hind legs.
Shen Wuming walked over and held the fox's neck with one hand to prevent it from escaping.
Then step on the edge of the bear trap and use your other hand to pull the trap open.
Lift the little fox up.
"Supper is ready..."
Shen Wuming breathed a sigh of relief, but at this moment, a crisp sound suddenly came from his ears.
